name: agent-skill-catalog
input_contract: One or more explicit local roots containing SKILL.md files, plus optional scoped overrides and image metadata. Missing family-primary repository links may be searched in a bounded concurrent GitHub pass; search only generates candidates, and automatic association requires a matching remote SKILL.md plus a unique high-confidence evidence result.
output_contract: Deterministic catalog.json, description-enrichment.json, resumable description-batch.json workflow, and self-contained index.html with skills, plugin aggregates, families, category evidence, confidence, Agent-reviewed Chinese descriptions, best-evidence aggregate images, invocation, GitHub metadata, cached GitHub previews, and output-owned manual overrides. The final Agent run uses --require-complete-descriptions and requires pending_description_count to be zero.
rollback_boundary: Only the selected output directory may be overwritten. GitHub preview cache and manual image overrides stay inside that directory; scanned roots are read-only.
network_policy: Allow bounded HTTPS GitHub candidate search and remote SKILL.md verification, observed or verified repository-page reads, bounded README excerpts, and allowlisted GitHub image hosts. Use --no-github-discovery --no-github-images for an offline build, and also --no-github-readmes when processing the description queue.
review_notes: For every public release, review trigger behavior, output quality, permission scope, trust evidence, package contents, and clean-install results.
